HUB 3.0.4 for Windows

What's new

• Spine CC Packer: Auto-convert to 3.6 detects supported original Spine 3.8 and 4.2 exports. Supported 4.2 easing, transforms and slot colors become legacy-compatible keys without changing duration.

• Modern atlas support: converts supported 4.2 atlas layouts and checks required image regions. Texture pixels remain unchanged.

• Conversion fix: output targets 3.6 even when the existing game JSON reports 3.8, 4.2 or has no version header. Preview shows source, output and existing versions. Exports stay untouched and packing retains backups.

• Updates placement: the window opens centered over HUB on its current monitor and recenters when reopened.

• Clearer update status: theme-matched banners above the notes. Green means available, up to date or verified; blue means working; amber means warning; red means error. No empty banner space when idle.

Asset Stage / Live Edit and Audio Volume Match remain beta-only and are not included. Existing Stable tools are retained. Blue update notifications remain Stable-only; Beta checks are manual.

Conversion limits

4.2 curves are sampled into legacy keys, not kept as editable 4.2 handles. Unsupported physics, constraints, inheritance, deformation, attachment sequences and unknown data are blocked before writes. Test playback and mixing in your game before bulk packing.

Auto-conversion is off by default. Already-legacy 3.6/3.7 exports retain the unchanged-copy behavior.

How to update

Open Updates → Stable → Check now → Download update → Install & restart.

Users on 3.0.3 can update directly, with no intermediate Beta required. Settings and history are preserved. Installation requires confirmation and is blocked while an editing job is running.

For a new installation or a version without the updater, extract HUB-v3.0.4-release.zip and run HUB/HUB.exe, or use the included installer. Keep the complete HUB folder together. Use CC Packer's Preview before packing.

Windows only. The macOS release is unchanged.
